description: Permanently delete a campaign, ad squad, ad or audience. Heavily guarded: the item must be PAUSED (audiences excepted), must have spent nothing in the last 30 days, a campaign must have no ACTIVE ad squads, and you must pass confirm_name equal to its exact name. Cannot be undone. Previews (and shows any blockers) unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token. Use only for items you are sure about; deleting cannot be undone. To stop delivery use snap_set_status with PAUSED instead.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

confirm_name.description: Exact name of the item, copied from the preview

entity.description: What to act on: campaign, adsquad or ad (ad squads are Snapchat's ad sets).

id.description: Id of the item named by entity. Get it from snap_list_campaigns, snap_list_adsquads or snap_list_ads.

name: snap_delete
